title: Bullet: Boosting GPU Utilization for LLM Serving through Spatial-Temporal GPU Resource Sharing
summary_zh: 以 SM-scaling roofline model 為核心的 spatial-temporal orchestration 系統：同時執行 prefill 與 decode，並透過 SM masking 動態配置 GPU resources。針對 prefill compute-bound 與 decode memory-bound 的 mismatch，Bullet 不只調 batch，而是把兩個 phase 的資源空間拆開管理。實驗在 ShareGPT、Azure-Code、arXiv-Summary 與 A100/H100/H20 上驗證，平均 throughput 提升 1.26×、最高 1.55×，並維持 latency target。
summary_en: Spatial-temporal orchestration system centered on an SM-scaling roofline model: prefill and decode run concurrently while SM masking dynamically provisions GPU resources. Instead of only tuning hybrid batch size, Bullet separates the resource space of compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode. Evaluated on ShareGPT, Azure-Code, arXiv-Summary and A100/H100/H20, it reports 1.26× average and up to 1.55× throughput gain while meeting latency targets.
